state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I found the red ball and stopped about 20 cm from it. I then called rest, so the robot is crouched with its motors off.

The ball was on the floor, just ahead and slightly to the left, in the bottom-camera view. I turned about 0.2 rad (about 11°) left to face it. The rest call interrupted that turn, so it may not have finished.

The last two camera frames, taken after the rest call, show the box and black case, not the ball. The bottom camera only sees the floor ahead of the feet. I can't confirm the ball's position from them, and I didn't check that the robot ended up facing it.

The search took a while. I first went the wrong way, and later ended up behind the cardboard box. The ball was in the open part of the room, near the black case.
